rules.other_methods: fixed descriptive panels; never select a per-case winner
rules.synthetic_absolute: global MSE or time-change MAE >= exploration within-K90th percentile
rules.synthetic_local_global_normal: global MSE <= within-K median AND boundary_0_2 MAE >= within-K90th percentile
rules.normal_control: within-K global MSE interquartile range AND boundary MAE <= median; nearest input-proxy match, prefer different source group
rules.davis_candidates: VEPI-public-mp4 <=10th percentile OR <=MPIB-0.02; codec |delta| >=90th percentile reported separately
rules.selection: up to3 candidates/category, prefer distinct source groups; retain full exploration flags; no visual inference

region_protocol.foreground: reference alpha >= 230/255; DAVIS original mask resized with nearest-neighbor, nonzero foreground
region_protocol.boundary: 3x3 morphological gradient of alpha>=128/255; Euclidean distance to gradient pixels at output resolution
region_protocol.disparity_edge: max absolute 4-neighbor difference of supplied PNG8 disparity >=4 units, dilated with 5x5 ones; reference-defined, not prediction-defined
region_protocol.empty: null metric and zero pixel count; excluded from scene/group means with valid counts reported
region_protocol.scene_aggregation: sum absolute/squared RGB error over all region pixels and frames divided by pixel_count*3; temporal mask is union of adjacent reference regions over24 transitions
region_protocol.cross_scene_aggregation: unweighted scene means and separately unweighted source-group means of scene means; shared-source scenes are not independent replications
region_protocol.synthetic_reference: MPIB-public sRGB proxy GT, not physical paired ground truth
region_protocol.davis_reference: input RGB for modification diagnostics only, not bokeh GT; no motion compensation

existing_metric_definitions.SSIM: Gaussian sigma1.5, RGB, skimage population covariance
existing_metric_definitions.FD: torchvision RAFT-large C_T_SKHT_V2, full resolution, mean L1 flow difference over 24 transitions
existing_metric_definitions.RM: mean absolute difference of predicted and reference frame differences over all 24 transitions
existing_metric_definitions.FVD: not computed: distribution-estimator protocol not configured for this run
existing_metric_definitions.PSNR_clip_mse: PSNR from pooled MSE over the 25-frame clip; separate from mean frame PSNR

metric_limits: ATB per-clip TorchMetrics PSNR/SSIM and author2-pair RM unavailable: null, not synthesized; common comparisons use same skimage PSNR/SSIM and RM24.
Global existing RM24 and new CPU time_change_MAE use the same unwarped frame-difference expression; boundary bins are new diagnostics. They do not establish flicker.
FVD is dataset-level and never used for per-video ranking.
DAVIS uses input modification diagnostics, not paired bokeh error; no motion compensation.
Shared-source scenes are not independent repeats; no significance or visual conclusions.
